hooks.command: set -eu; for nb in 01_descriptiv 02_frekvens 03_severity 04_tweedie 05_catboost model_results; do p=/workspaces/MotorForsikring; if [ -f $p/$nb.ipynb ] && [ $p/$nb.ipynb -nt $p/py_mirrors/$nb.py ]; then uv run --project /workspaces/MotorForsikring jupytext --sync $p/$nb.ipynb; fi; done
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) uv run --project /workspaces/MotorForsikring ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
